remarks: Looking for a very nice single family rental in a great location? This is it! East Norwalk. This single family (located in rear) offers 2+ bedrooms. Updated, clean and bright.  Recently updated, all new appliances and efficient gas heat. 2 entrances on main level into Living Room or Eat-in-Kitchen. In addition, 1st floor bedroom & laundry off of kitchen. 2nd floor Master BR w/double closets, office or nursery and full bath on upper level. Newer windows. Backyard and room for a garden. Off street parking for 2 cars. Walk or bike to all East Norwalk amenities, beaches, train station, shops restaurants or nearby SoNo. Come and enjoy the lifestyle of 06855! Must have good credit and references.  Convenient location for commuters - only 55 miles north of NYC and 10 minute walk to East Norwalk train station. Plenty of storage in full basement w/bulkhead entry.
